meta.name: competitive-pricing-strategy
meta.description: Build an evidence-based competitive pricing strategy for ecommerce products. Use when a seller asks how to position a price against competitors, set regular and promotional prices, protect contribution margin, design bundles or price tiers, respond to competitor moves, or coordinate prices across Amazon, Shopify, TikTok Shop, Walmart, eBay, or other channels. Do not use for automated repricing implementation or claims of a mathematically proven optimal price without sufficient data.

copy.tagline: 制定基于证据的竞争定价策略
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果卖家需要科学定价并管理多渠道价格
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to set evidence-based prices across multiple sales channels

howto.what: 根据竞争对手报价、成本和品牌定位，为每个商品制定价格策略、应对降价的规则，并给出分步实施计划。
howto.when: 当卖家询问如何与竞争对手定价、设置常规或促销价格、保护利润、设计捆绑或层级、应对竞争对手行动，或跨渠道协调价格时。

say.text: 比较这6个竞争对手报价，告诉我应该定什么价。
为我的高端护肤品制定在亚马逊和Shopify上的上市定价策略。
主要竞争对手降价15%，我应该跟进还是维持原价？

howto.what_en: Transforms competitor offers, costs, and brand positioning into SKU-level price architecture, competitor-response rules, and a controlled rollout plan.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a seller asks about competitive pricing, setting regular/promotional prices, protecting margin, designing bundles/tiers, responding to competitor moves, or coordinating prices across channels like Amazon, Shopify, etc.

say_en.text: Compare these six competitor offers and tell me where my product should be priced.
Build a launch pricing strategy for my premium skincare product on Amazon and Shopify.
My main competitor cut price by 15%. Should I match them or hold my position?
